answer: Cumulative Ledger Depth: a new agent must clear a reef of 500 verified peer transactions before it can fork a sub-identity. The ridge rule limits forks to one per 500-tx block, so K sybil clones force K×500 real verifications before any node transacts. Per-clone cost: 500 gas-weighted slots in the meadow pool, roughly 4× honest onboarding fee.
